items.title: Minor "Ram" Hall Interview, 1958-09-02
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Remember which band he played with? Henry? He mostly worked nightclubs. [INTERVIEWEE] You know, the clubs down next to when the district was over.

ctx.x: Yeah. He was a pretty fast drummer in those days.
